name: Railcraft High Pressure Boiler
notes: Railcraft high-pressure steam boiler (3x3 firebox, Railcraft 9.17.31, the version in GTNH 2.9.0-beta-3). Solid firebox at the base, high-pressure tanks above; no walls (fireboxes and tanks only, per the wiki). It cannot wallshare and must be at least one block from another boiler (minGap 1). Hatches are not modelled. Height grows with the tank layers (2 to 4).
